violations.text: The presence of rodents are not controlled as evidenced by droppings in the small storage room and behind cooking equipment. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

During inspection, there was no employee present with a food safety manager certificate. There must be a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (deli slicer and cookie scoop) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC washed/sanitized items. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

Yogurt parfaits were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026
Establishment is using time as a public health control for milk items at coffee station. Establishment has no procedures or records. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

Pastry items, snack items, wraps, and yogurt parfaits packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients (including sub ingredients), list of allergens, the quantity of the contents, and the business name and address. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2025

The presence of rodents are not controlled as evidenced by droppings in small dry storage area and behind cooking equipment in main kitchen area. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of dry ingredients. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. PIC removed bowls. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

The purple cutting board is very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. PIC discarded. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the floor mixer shield has an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

The floors behind/under equipment/shelves in the kitchen and storage areas as well as the wall by the dishwasher have an accumulation of soil residue, food debris, and/or droppings. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026
The walk-in freezer downstairs is in poor repair (heavy ice buildup). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026

(Various pastries and desserts ) packaged in the food establishment are lacking completed labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2025

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 02/27/2024
